title: Habari na maoni
description: Fuatilia habari, sema unachofikiri, na ukubali au ukatae kwa adabu.

sentences.target: Dad reads the newspaper every morning.
altTarget: Father reads the newspaper every morning.
Dad is reading the newspaper every morning.

sentences.target: I heard the news on the radio.
The news is at eight in the evening.
sentences.base: Taarifa ya habari ni saa mbili usiku.
altTarget: The news bulletin is at 8 pm.

sentences.target: The event happened in town yesterday.
altTarget: The incident happened in town yesterday.

sentences.target: I think it will rain today.
In my opinion, school is very important.
sentences.base: Kwa maoni yangu, shule ni muhimu sana.

sentences.target: Sorry, I don’t agree with you.
altTarget: Excuse me, I disagree with you.
Sorry, I do not agree with you.

dialogues.speaker: juma
dialogues.target: I think our team will win.

guidebook.intro: Fuatilia habari kwa Kiingereza, toa maoni yako na ukubali au ukatae kwa adabu.

phrases.target: Sorry, I don’t agree with you.

tips.title: The news ni kimoja
body: **News** huonekana kama wingi, lakini ni kimoja: **The news is good** (habari ni nzuri), si “the news are”. Habari moja: **a piece of news**.
Kwenye redio au TV: **the news** (taarifa ya habari), **a headline** (kichwa cha habari), **a newspaper** au **a paper**.

tips.title: I think, I agree
body: Anza maoni na **I think…** (nadhani), **In my opinion…** (kwa maoni yangu). **I agree** ni nakubali, na **I don’t agree** au **I disagree** ni sikubaliani.
Kwa adabu: **Sorry, but I don’t agree.** au **I see your point, but…** (naelewa, lakini…).

culture.title: BBC Swahili
body: Watu wengi Afrika Mashariki husikiliza habari za Kiingereza na Kiswahili kwenye redio za kimataifa. Kusikiliza habari kila siku ni njia nzuri ya kuboresha Kiingereza chako.

stories.title: Gazeti la asubuhi
stories.summary: Baraka na Juma wanasoma gazeti wakinywa chai, na hawakubaliani kabisa.

line.speaker: baraka
line.target: Juma, have you read today’s paper?

line.speaker: juma
line.target: Not yet. What news is there?

line.speaker: baraka
line.target: The government will build a new road in our village.
line.base: Serikali itajenga barabara mpya kijijini kwetu.

line.speaker: juma
line.target: In my opinion, water is more important than a road.
line.base: Kwa maoni yangu, maji ni muhimu kuliko barabara.

line.speaker: baraka
line.target: Sorry, I don’t agree. A road will bring business.

steps.question: Juma anafikiri nini ni muhimu zaidi?

line.speaker: juma
line.target: Then let’s write our opinions to the paper!
line.base: Basi, tuandike maoni yetu kwa gazeti!
